description: Official Go SDK for Xquik's X/Twitter API: tweet search, user lookup, media workflows, monitors, webhooks, and automation.
rules: Authenticate with option.WithAPIKey or the X_TWITTER_SCRAPER_API_KEY environment variable.
Use client.X.Tweets.Search for tweet search and client.X.Users for user lookup and follower workflows.
Use api.md for generated method coverage and pkg.go.dev links for Go type signatures.
Never expose API keys, webhook signing values, or user credentials in examples, logs, or commits.
